resources.string: Add your Anthropic key to use Gloss.
Couldn\'t reach Anthropic. Check your internet connection.
The AI couldn\'t answer just now.
Couldn\'t save the Note. It\'s kept here: try Save again.
Over 80% of this month\'s spending limit.
This month\'s spending limit is reached. Gloss works again on %1$s, or raise the limit in Settings.
Legado can\'t open the book\'s file; re-open the book in Legado
Nothing here yet. Select text in Legado and tap Define, Explain or Note: every answer and Note is kept here, by book.
Delete this Lookup and its chat?
Gloss answers with your own Anthropic API key. Paste it here: it is checked with a small test call, then stored encrypted on this phone and never backed up.
Anthropic didn\'t accept this key. Check it and try again.
Couldn\'t reach Anthropic to check the key. Check your internet connection.
Anthropic refused the test call (Share log below shows why, such as no credit). Try again in a moment.
The key was accepted but couldn\'t be stored securely on this phone. Try again.

For answers that know your book, switch on Legado\'s Web service: in Legado, tap My, then turn on Web service. While it\'s on, others on the same Wi-Fi can see your bookshelf, so turn it off on Wi-Fi you don\'t control.
Gloss can reach Legado. Define and Explain will use the book you\'re reading.
Gloss can\'t reach Legado: its Web service is off, or Legado isn\'t running.
Legado didn\'t answer in time. Try again in a moment.
Legado answered with an error. Share log below shows more.
Select text in Legado, Chrome or any app, then tap Define, Explain or Note in the menu over the selection. It may be under ⋮ or More.
The log records what Gloss did (model, tokens, timings, errors), never what you selected or the answers.
